CONFIDENTIAL
October 20, 1941.

Arrest of Tsai Hong Dien, Commissioner of Civil
Administration Department of Kiangsu Provincial
Government and two sectional chiefs.

From information received, it is reported that
Tsai Hong Dien (蔡洪田), Commissioner of Civil
Administration Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Government, and Hsu Kwang Loh (徐光) and Wong
Tsung Yuen (王春元), sectional chiefs of the same
Department, were arrested at the beginning of October,
1941 by the Nanking Government for corrupt practices.

It is learned that the arrests was the result of
an accusation made to the Nanking Government by Fan
Yong Chi (潘宏器), Magistrate of Kiangtu Hsien (江
都縣), in the middle of September, 1941, against the
aforementioned persons for attempting to extort $50,000
from him. Soon afterwards, the family of the late
Ho Tsoong Chuan (胡宗銓) an employee of the Kiangsu
Provincial Government, also charged them with having
illegally deducted $10,000 from the compassionate-grant
(which was $30,000) issued to the family by Nanking
Government after the assassination of Ho Tsoong Chuan.
The Nanking Government therefore instructed Lee Shih Chun
(李士群), Commissioner of the Investigation and
Statistical Department, to investigate the charges; In
both cases the charges were found to be genuine and the
three men were subsequently arrested.

Following the arrest of Tsai Hong Dien, his
family immediately appealed to Lee Shih Chun for help,
with the result that Tsai was released on October 14,
but he is not permitted to leave Nanking until after
the conclusion of the case. Hsu Kwang Loh and Wong
Tsung Yuen were transferred to the Nanking District
Court on the same date pending trial.

机密
1941年10月20日。

江苏省政府民政厅厅长蔡洪田及两名科长被捕。

据所获情报报告，江苏省政府民政厅厅长蔡洪田（Tsai Hong Dien），以及该厅科长徐光（Hsu Kwang Loh）和王春元（Wong Tsung Yuen），于1941年10月初因贪污行为被南京政府逮捕。

据悉，此次逮捕源于江都县县长潘宏器（Fan Yong Chi）于1941年9月中旬向南京政府提出指控，指称上述三人企图向其勒索5万美元。不久之后，已故江苏省政府雇员胡宗銓（Ho Tsoong Chuan）的家属也指控他们非法克扣南京政府在胡宗銓遇刺后发给其家属的抚恤金（金额为3万元）中的1万美元。因此，南京政府指令调查统计局局长李士群（Lee Shih Chun）调查这些指控；在两起案件中，指控均被证实属实，随后这三名男子被捕。

蔡洪田被捕后，其家属立即向李士群求助，结果是蔡于10月14日获释，但在案件结案前不得离开南京。徐光和王春元于同日被移送南京地方法院候审。

（左侧批注框：档案 21. 10. 41.）
（左下角印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年10月21日）

It is recalled that Tsai Hong Dien was once a
Standing Committee member of the local Tangpu (Chungking
Government). In Winter, 1939, he surrendered to the
Wang Ching Wei Clique together with the radiotelegraph
machine which belonged to the former Tangpu. For
this reason, he was much favoured by the Wang Party
and later appointed as Chairman of the local
Kuomintang Headquarters. In Summer, 1940, he was
transferred to the post of Commissioner of Civil
Administration Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Government.

Subject Bank of Kiangsu at Soochow.

Made by....................and........................Forwarded by...Supt. Tan Shao Liang

According to arrivals from Soochow there are
no indications, so far, that the Bank of Kiangsu, an organiza-
tion established at Soochow by Civil Governor Chen Cheh Ming
(陈则民), is planning to enforce circulation of bank notes
in Shanghai, the principal reason being that the circulation
will undoubtedly meet with opposition from banking circles
here. At present the bank forms the treasury of the
Kiangsu Provincial Government and handles receipts of taxes
etc. It is difficult to tell when the new notes of the
bank will be put into circulation in Soochow where Japanese
notes called "Lau Der Piao"(老頭票) are accepted in
exchange shops.

Date July 5 19 38.

Subject New appointments to the Kiangsu Provincial Government
at Soochow.

Made by ________ and ________ Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

Owing to the war torn cities of Chinkiang and
Wusieh being unsuitable as the seat of the Kiangsu Provincial
Government, Chen Cheh Ming(陳別民), a Japanese educated
Chinese lawyer, whose biography was given in a report dated
March 31, took over the office of Civil Governor of Kiangsu
at Soochow. The Provincial Government was officially inaugura-
ted on June 24.

Chen acts concurrently as Commissioner of Finance,
Yu Pao Hsien(于宝軒) is the Commissioner of Civil Administra-
tion, Pan Chun Siao(潘振霄), a member of the Soochow gentry,
is Commissioner of Education, Yen Chia Chi(嚴家熾) is
Commissioner of Construction and Chen Ping Yu(程平予) is
Police Commissioner. Kyung Kuo Liang(龔國樑), a well
known figure in the Marine Police in Soochow, has been
appointed Chief of the Marine Police.

Chen Cheh Ming has raised much money by collecting
taxes for conditions in Soochow are returning to normalcy.
He contemplates the formation of a "Bank of Kiangsu" which will
issue notes to replace the Chinese Government notes. One Hsu
Sung Kung(许迪公) is undertaking the preparations. In this
connection it may be interesting to note that there is already
a bank called "Bank of Kiangsu" at 371 Kiangse Road.

$100,000 worthless notes bearing the name of the
defunct Fong Dah Bank (Shantung 1920) were seized by Chengtu
Road Police on June 26 whilst under transportation to Soochow
for the use of the proposed Bank in Soochow.

主题：苏州江苏省政府的新任命。

由 ________ 和 ________ 制作，经谭绍良警司转发

由于镇江和无锡战火纷飞，不宜作为江苏省政府所在地，一位受过日本教育的中国律师陈则民（Chen Cheh Ming，原文误植为陳別民，应为陈则民），其生平已在3月31日的报告中提供，在苏州接任江苏民政长官一职。省政府于6月24日正式成立。

陈兼任财政厅长，于宝軒（Yu Pao Hsien）任民政厅长，苏州士绅潘振霄（Pan Chun Siao）任教育厅长，嚴家熾（Yen Chia Chi）任建设厅长，程平予（Chen Ping Yu）任警察局长。龚国梁（Kyung Kuo Liang），苏州水上警察中的知名人物，已被任命为水上警察局长。

陈则民通过征税筹集了大量资金，因为苏州的局势正恢复正常。他考虑成立一家“江苏银行”，发行钞票以取代中国政府钞票。许迪公（Hsu Sung Kung）一人正在负责筹备工作。与此相关，值得注意的是，江西路371号已经有一家名为“江苏银行”的银行。

6月26日，成都路巡捕房在运输途中查获了10万美元印有已倒闭的丰大银行（山东，1920年）名称的废钞，这些钞票原本拟运往苏州供拟议中的苏州银行使用。

July 11, 1938. Morning Translation.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao :-

“REFORMED GOVERNMENT” AND LEGAL TENDER NOTES

With a view to collecting legal tender notes, Chen Cheh-min (陳則民), Governor of Kiangsu Province, appointed by the "Reformed Government of the Chinese Republic," established a Kiangsu District Bank in May this year, which was scheduled to be formally inaugurated at Soochow on July 15.

According to information secured by this paper from local banking circles yesterday, the internal arrangements of this new bank are nearing completion. About 60 employees who are mostly former discharged or dismissed employees of local banks have been taken on. After its inauguration, the bank intends to issue a large quantity of banknotes in the hope of collecting legal tender notes for the purchase of foreign currency. A certain large printing press is now undertaking the printing of these notes by adding on them the inscription "Kiangsu District Bank". The notes consist of the following denominations: $1, $5, $10, $50 and $100. It is said that the inauguration of the bank will not be able to take place on July 15.

1938年7月11日。晨间翻译。

华美晨报 :-

“维新政府”与法币

为了收集法币，由“中华民国维新政府”任命的江苏省省长陈则民（Chen Cheh-min）于今年5月成立了一家江苏区银行，该银行定于7月15日在苏州正式开业。

据本报昨日从本地银行界获得的消息，这家新银行的内部安排已接近完成。大约60名员工已被录用，他们大多是本地银行的前离职或被解雇员工。开业后，该银行打算发行大量钞票，希望能借此收集法币以购买外汇。某大型印刷厂目前正在承印这些钞票，并在上面加印“江苏区银行”字样。钞票面额如下：1元、5元、10元、50元和100元。据说该银行的开业无法按计划在7月15日举行。

About 20 years ago, I was a magistrate in Kashing, Kazeu
and Pingwo Hsiens of the Chekiang Province the chairman of
which was one named Chu Yang Kwang who was under the leadership
of the late President Yuen Shih Kai. I held the job of magis-
trate for about 7 years. Later, I resigned from my job because
of sickness. I came to Shanghai afterwards and took up residence
in the City, Nantao. About ? years later -exact date forgotten-
I went to Peking in an effort to secure a post, and when I
arrived at that port, I met an old acquaintance named Peu Shing
Hang who was then the minister of the Financial Department of
the Peking Government, Tuan Chi Zai being the Provisional
President. In the course of conversation, Peu Shing Hang told
me that it was his personal plan to open a Fong Dah Bank in
Tsinanfu, Shantung Province and that he would appoint me as an
assistant manager of that bank. When the bank came into being
in the 6th or 7th year of the Republic of China (1917 or 1918),
I worked in the bank as an assistant manager and it was the
9th year of the Republic of China (1920) that I was instructed
by Peu Shing Hang to come to Shanghai in order to establish a
branch bank. I came to Shanghai as instructed and later
established a branch bank on Nanking Road and on instructions
of Peu, I acted myself as manager of the branch bank. Owing
to the fact that the Fong Dah Bank Head Office had no banknotes
to be issued to the public, Peu instructed me to negotiate with
the Commercial Press and I, acting on these instructions,
proceeded to a Printing Office of the above firm in Chapel and
requested them to print 300,000 $1 notes which they did. When

In the 17th year of the Republic of China (1928) when I
was working in the Consolidated Tax Bureau, Soochow, I became
friendly with Yuen Ying Fong. Later we both parted and I
did not see him again for about 10 years.

When the conflict broke out in 1937, I evacuated to
Shanghai, living at the above premises.

In April 1937, Yuen Ying Fong came to my home and told me
that he was going back to Soochow and stated that he
would appoint me chief of a certain department in that part,
and I thanked him.

At the end of May this year, I proceeded to Soochow
with Yuen Ying Fong to take up my office but I was unsuccessful,
as the Peace Maintenance Corps there refused to hand their
official documents to me. I then returned to Shanghai with
Yuen Ying Fong. Later, Yuen Ying Fong told me that he was in
possession of large number of Fon; Yah Bank notes and
instructed me to transport same to one named Kung Tseh Ming,
Chairman of Soochow Province, in order to be put into use in
the interior, and to this I agreed. It was unexpected that
Yuen was arrested by police who seized a large number of
the above mentioned notes. Later Yuen led detectives to my
home and I was thus arrested.

At the Station, I explained the above facts to investigating detectives.

The above is my true statement.

Signed, crossmarked & thumbprinted.

中华民国十七年（1928年），我在苏州统税局工作时，与阮英芳（Yuen Ying Fong）结识并成为朋友。后来我们分别，大约十年未曾见面。

1937年战事爆发时，我撤离到上海，居住在上述地址。

1937年4月，阮英芳来到我家，告诉我他打算回苏州，并表示会任命我担任该地区某个部门的主任，我向他致谢。

今年五月底，我随阮英芳前往苏州就职，但未成功，因为当地的和平维持队拒绝向我移交官方文件。随后我与阮英芳返回上海。后来，阮英芳告诉我他拥有大量丰业银行（Fon; Yah Bank，原文如此）钞票，并指示我将这些钞票运送给一位名为龚泽明（Kung Tseh Ming，音译）的人，即苏州省主席（Chairman of Soochow Province，原文如此），以便在内地投入使用，我对此表示同意。没想到阮被警察逮捕，警方查获了大量上述钞票。后来阮带领侦探来到我家，我因此被捕。

在警局，我向调查侦探解释了上述事实。

以上是我的真实陈述。

我是上述住所的二房东。

1935年5月21日，经我的朋友应来定（Ying Lai Ding，音译）介绍，阮英芳及其亲戚洪梅仙（Hong Mei Sien，音译，老妇人）搬入我家，他们以每月7.00美元的价格租住了厨房楼上的一间房间。
